decisions.reason: The devore decoration fabric remains a differentiated option whose demand is still uncertain; keeping costs are low relative to the option value.
Transparent burnout decorative fabric is a niche option with unresolved market acceptance, so the firm keeps the option open.
As a core decorative burnout option, there is no negative performance signal to justify abandonment, so it is kept.
Velour-like upholstery fabric has uncertain but potentially stable demand from furniture producers, so the option is retained.
Flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a technical textile option with regulatory-driven demand and low keeping costs, so it is kept.
Although polyester lining is more commodity-like, the absence of clear negative results means the firm keeps the option while monitoring.
